en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a Baroque riverside palace with mansard roofs and ornate balconies on the right, its terrace and formal garden overlooking a broad river. Several people stroll or stand along the riverside parapet and path. On the left a river steamer with a flag at the stern travels upstream, while wooded banks extend into the distance under a cloudy sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.
